crime_highlights: Mr. Neel stabbed January Lapuz with the intent to defend himself, he used more force than was reasonable in the circumstances
Charles Neel obtaining a knife and stabbing January Lapuz in an attempt to defend himself
Ms. Lapuz suffered numerous stab wounds, resulting in significant injury, specifically to her vertebral artery and jugular vein, as a result of which she died
rationale_highlights: I must pay attention to the circumstances of Mr. Neel's aboriginal heritage as it relates to this offence
note: Court never states the effect of heritage on sentence; joint submission accepted.

crime_highlights: Mr. Anderson and three others entered a home known to be occupied
They assaulted the male occupant and forced him and the three female occupants to lie face down on the main floor of the house
The intruders took turns holding a machete against the neck of the male occupant
they were severely shaken by the events that evening
rationale_highlights: Those factors must be considered in this case in accordance with 718.2 of the Criminal Code
Mr. Anderson's grandmother grew up on the Oregon Jack Creek Reserve. She attended residential school.
I conclude that this is a case in which departure from the range is appropriate.
if I am to do more than pay lip service to the principles articulated in R. v. Gladue, [1999] 1 S.C.R. 688 I am compelled to depart from the usual range

crime_highlights: Mr. Sanderson's shank, wielded by Mr. Sanderson, did inflict an injury upon Germa
Germa sustained a laceration to his right lower chin, a stab wound in the area of his chest and a small abrasion to the area of his left shoulder
The stab wound in his chest in particular required emergency medical attention
He spent about two weeks in hospital
rationale_highlights: Considering the systemic factors that are referred to in the authorities provided, the severely disadvantaged personal background of Mr. Sanderson as a First Nations person
I find a fit sentence within the range of authorities provided to be a three year sentence of imprisonment
note: Para 58 is Gladue report; para 75 implicitly adopts it. Crime passage mixes act and harm.
